title: Progress Heartbeat
description: Stops people waiting on a dead job or killing a live one by telling working from stalled (no heartbeat for N seconds → "No progress for 40s" with Retry), separating "alive but not advancing" from silence, showing a time-left range that widens instead of a jumpy countdown, and holding the bar at 99% until the job reports done.
stops: Killed a job that was still running
